title: Agent pane, part 1: dock a mock chat, type and send a prompt into its page, stop, allow and deny with nothing pending, leave and resume it
preconditions: private scratch config (driver_app: bench config, ui.animations.enabled false)
a fresh saved session: one workspace, one terminal tab

steps.note: a person's Cmd-I docks the workspace's agent chat on the left and focuses it (DockedAgentChat.open); the bench launch runs the mock agent (CMUX_NEXT_AGENT_PANE_MOCK=1)
one chat tab, a new chat with no session yet

expect.noReceiptReason: typing into the chat composer runs no registry action

steps.note: the chat is a Chromium page (agentChromium), so its page window is the key window (keyWindow page); the shell window would give the keys to the terminal. The new chat's composer text reaches the app as its unsent draft (chat.unsentDraft, the last text always goes), hashed only: the wait holds for exactly `hello`

expect.noReceiptReason: Return sends the composer's prompt to the page's agent, not a registry action

steps.note: Return in the chat's page sends the prompt to the mock agent: the composer empties, and the app forgets the unsent draft (AgentUnsentDrafts.set with blank text). The mock's reply stays in the page (the untested entry)
Stop Agent Turn on the focused chat: the app sees no turn of the mock (no session), so no app facet changes; whether the mock's reply is still streaming in the page is not read
a person's Allow Once (agentPane.permission.allowOnce); no permission is pending, so nothing changes
a person's Deny (agentPane.permission.deny); no permission is pending, so nothing changes
Cmd-Opt-Right (Ghostty's focus-pane key) to the terminal right of the docked chat
Cmd-I again focuses the docked chat that is there; it opens no second chat (DockedAgentChat.open)

invariants: chat identity is stable: the chat the first Cmd-I opened is the one the second Cmd-I focuses (agents.sessions has one row from chat-listed to the end, the same tab)
the prompt reaches the chat's composer and is sent: draftSha256 is the hash of `hello` after type-prompt and null after send-prompt
stop, allow and deny with nothing pending change no chat state: their before and settled checkpoints agree on agents and topology
the person's chat keys run their registry actions (receipts), and focus returns to the chat on resume
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started and its tag's daemons (TagTeardown)
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: this case is not the agent-pane P0 journey (priority P1): it never starts a fixture turn the app sees, streams tool progress, expands or collapses output, approves or denies a pending request, or stops a running turn. The mock agent pane never gives the app a session (webviews agent-session/acpmux/App.tsx persistSession skips the mock), so no app facet shows the mock's seeded open turns or permission waits (acpmux/mock.ts openTurns): agents.sessions state, turn and pendingApprovals come only from acpmux's lane. The P0 journey needs a fixture agent with a session the app sees
the mock's reply to the prompt: no app facet reads the chat's conversation
Session Info (agentPane.toggleInspector) needs a run that may change the view
